name: SAML 2.0 Identity Provider
author: McSparrow <hi@mcsparrow.dev>
description: SAML 2.0 service provider. Hosts the SP metadata at /api/identity-providers/{id}/metadata (consumed by the IdP) and accepts AuthnResponse POSTs at /api/identity-providers/acs. Required fields: entity_id (SP entity ID), default_role_id; optional metadata_url (auto-populate IdP SSO URL + cert), idp_entity_id, idp_sso_url, idp_certificate, group_attribute_name. Compatible with Okta, Azure AD, OneLogin, Auth0, Google Workspace, AD FS. Tile shows up in Settings > Security > Identity Providers as 'SAML 2.0'.
